m: निर्-√ भा P. -भाति (pf. -बभौ), to shine forth, appear, arise, Mn.; Kāv.; Pur.; to look like, seem to be (इव), MBh. viii, 3141.
a: निर्भा — {c2c} P. 1 To shine forth, shine अक्षबीजवलयेन निर्बभौ R. 11. 66. --2 To proceed, arise, start into view; वेदाद्धर्मो हि निर्बभौ Ms. 5. 44; 2. 10.

m: निर्—भाग mfn. not consisting of parts
निर्—भाग—त्व n., Kap.

= दीप्त, L.
निर्-˚भात mfn. shone or shining forth, appeared, arisen, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
निर्—भी mfn. fearless, not afraid.

निर्-˚भूति (निर्-) f. disappearing, vanishing, AV.
निर्-√ भञ्ज् P. -भनक्ति (2. sg. impf. -अभनस्; Impv. -बन्धि, AV. iii, 6, 7), to break or split asunder, defeat, AV.; R. (w.r. -भजन्ति for भञ्ज्˚, v, 73, 37).

a: निर्भग्न — a. 1 Shattered, broken in pieces. --2 Bent, bowed.

निर्-˚भज्यमान mfn. being broken in pieces, BhP.
1. निर्—भक्त mfn. (medicine) taken without eating, Suśr.
2. निर्-˚भक्त mfn. excluded from participation, MW.
निर्-√ भल् (only pr. p. f. -भालयन्ती in Prākṛt, Mālav. i, 3/4 v.l. -ध्यायन्ती), to see, perceive, notice = (and perhaps w.r. for) नि-भ्˚.

a: निर्भर्त्स् — {c10c} A. 1 To revile, censure, abuse. --2 To surpass, eclipse, put to shame; Ku. 3. 53. 3 To menace; Śi. 6. 62.

a: निर्भर्त्सनं --ना — 1 Threat, menace; Śi. 15. 87. --2 Abuse, reproach, reviling, blame. --3 Malignity. --4 Red paint, lac.

a: निर्भर्त्सित — p. p. 1 Threatened. --2 Abused, reproached.

m: निर्—भय n. fearlessness, security, Hcat.

split, rent, channel (of a river), Hariv.
betraying, revealing, Mālav. iv, 1/2.
a: निर्भेदः — 1 Bursting, dividing, splitting asunder. --2 A split, rent. --3 Disclosure, betrayal. --4 Explicit mention or declaration; निर्भेदादृतेऽपि मालविकायामयमुपन्यासः शंकयति M. 4. --5 The bed of a river. --6 Determination of an affair, event.

a: निर्भेद्य — a. 1 Having no rent. --2 Not to be pierced through. --3 Disappointed.

m: निर्—भृति mfn. without wages, hireless, L.

निर्-√ भिद् P. Ā. -भिनत्ति (2. sg. Subj. aor. -भेद्, RV. i, 104, 8; pf. -बिभेद, MBh. &c.; -बिभिदे, Hariv.; ind.p. -भिद्य, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.), to cleave or split asunder, divide, open, pierce, hurt, wound, destroy, RV. &c. &c.; (with लोचने) to put out, MBh.; (with खम्) to form an aperture, excavate, BhP.; (with ग्रन्थिम्) to loose, untie, ib.; to penetrate i.e. find out, investigate, discover, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Pass. -भिद्यते, to be broken asunder cleave or split open (intrans.), Up.; Suśr.; BhP.
a: निर्भिद् — {c7c} U. 1 To tear up, burst or tear asunder, break or pierce through; अनेन निर्भिन्नतनुः स वध्यः V. 5. 6; Bk. 9. 67; निर्भिद्योपरि कर्णिकारमुकलान्यालीयते षट्पदः V. 2. 23. --2 To disclose, betray, divulge; निर्भिन्नप्रायं रहस्यं Dk., वृत्तांतैकदेशं निर्बिभेद ibid.; Śi. 16. 23, U. 3. 1. --3 To break down, destroy. --4 To ascertain, find out, discover. --5 To excavate. --6 To put out (the eyes).

divided, separated, disunited
pierced, penetrated
found out, betrayed, Br.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
